lines.zh: 长袍拖着水，我一步步上岸。
lines.en: My robe trails water as I climb onto land.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草变成了海藻。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass turns to kelp.

lines.zh: 肩上披着壳，走起来咔咔响。
lines.en: Shell plates on my shoulders clack as I walk.

lines.zh: 我低着头，念着听不懂的词。
lines.en: Head down, I mutter words you can't follow.
Water drips from my sleeves.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，因为陆地陌生。
lines.en: I walk slowly; dry land is strange to me.

lines.zh: 脚下的泥，被我踩出咸味。
lines.en: The mud I tread gives off salt.

lines.zh: 我举起手，地上的影子跟着动。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the shadows on the ground move with it.
I circle the village first, to look it over.
Every step feels like walking underwater.
The scales on me rasp against the robe.
I walk toward the lighthouse.

lines.zh: 我举起手，水就从掌心滴下。
lines.en: I raise a hand and water drips from the palm.

lines.zh: 我在旱地上，走得像个病人。
lines.en: On dry ground I walk like an invalid.

lines.zh: 我的影子很长，而且会动。
lines.en: My shadow is long, and it moves.
The tide follows me ashore.
I stand still and my hem moves on its own.

lines.zh: 我在念一段很长的祷词。
lines.en: I'm reciting a long prayer.
The light in my palm brightens and dims.
The sea is far off and I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我抬手，一片珊瑚从土里冒出来。
lines.en: I raise a hand and coral pushes up through the soil.
It's too dry here. I'm uncomfortable.
I'm counting the hours of the tide.
The ground beneath me slowly turns wet.
I'm waiting for an answer.
Something moves under my robe.
A bell far off. I've noted it.
I bow my head. The prayer is finished.

lines.zh: 空气里的盐分，越来越浓。
lines.en: The salt in the air keeps thickening.

lines.zh: 我抬手，火把的光变蓝了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the torchlight turns blue.
Even my totem tastes of salt now.

lines.zh: 我看了你一眼，你退了半步。
lines.en: I look at you once and you step back half a pace.
You don't belong to the sea, and the sea wants you.
I raise a hand and you can't move.

lines.zh: 这身袍子，是从更深的地方带来的。
lines.en: This robe came from somewhere deeper.

lines.zh: 不死图腾挂在我腰间，晃着。
lines.en: The totem of undying sways at my waist.
I'm in no hurry. I have hours to spare.

lines.zh: 你脚边的地，已经开始潮了。
lines.en: The ground at your feet is already damp.

lines.zh: 我要在你身上种一点东西。
lines.en: I mean to plant something in you.
Don't be afraid. This is only the beginning.
My robe has been cut open.
I retreat; it's easier in the water.
That broke my prayer.
A piece of my shell has cracked.
It hurts, and I'm still standing.

lines.zh: 你知道你打断了什么吗？
lines.en: Do you know what you interrupted?
My blood is salt, like seawater.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，慢慢重新开始。
lines.en: I raise my hand and slowly begin again.

lines.zh: 你惹到了不该惹的东西。
lines.en: You've stirred something you shouldn't have.
The sea will remember for me.
What's in your hand. Is it alive?
I won't eat it. I want it to grow.
Set it down and let it touch water.
There's the sea's taste in that flesh.
What you offer, I accept.
I'll bury it in wet soil.

lines.zh: 别拿走，它已经开始变了。
lines.en: Don't take it back. It's already changing.
Stand back. I'm about to speak the words.
A little of this grows into a great deal.
I reach out, but not to take.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的袍子，湿了一片。
lines.en: You bump my robe and it wets a patch.
I lift my sleeve and push you back.
That left salt on your hands.

lines.zh: 我退开，脚下的地还湿着。
lines.en: I step back and the ground stays wet.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的袍，海水渗进鞋。
lines.en: You hit my robe and seawater soaks your boots.
Don't touch my shell. It's still growing.

lines.zh: 精英海嗣的肩膀，比礁石硬。
lines.en: An elite seaborn's shoulder is harder than reef stone.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你身上停了一瞬。
lines.en: My shadow rested on you for an instant.
This patch of ground belongs to the sea now.

lines.zh: 我们离得太近，你该走了。
lines.en: We're too close. You should go.
The seaborn have no need of this.
We share a stretch of water, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我念的每一句，都是给海的。
lines.en: Every word I speak is for the sea.
If that's your question, I won't answer.

lines.zh: 潮水上来的时候，我们都一样。
lines.en: When the tide rises, we are all the same.

lines.zh: 我身上没有留给谁的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing in me set aside for anyone.
This sea will remember me.
Between us there's a layer of water.
I'm not lonely. The sea is always here.
Ask the sea that question.
I wrap it in my sleeve and put it away.
It's growing warm in my hand.
I press it into the wet soil.

lines.zh: 这枚绿宝石，会变成别的东西。
lines.en: This emerald will become something else.
I tuck it in my robe so it won't dry.

lines.zh: 它在我手里长了一层薄壳。
lines.en: A thin shell grows over it in my hand.
This shouldn't be left on land.

lines.zh: 我拿着它，海就近了一点。
lines.en: Holding it, the sea feels nearer.
I bury it and wait for the change.
Keep it. This goes back with me.
You're standing very far from the sea.

lines.zh: 我看见了，那个亮着的村子。
lines.en: I see it, that lit village.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，手指对着你的窗。
lines.en: I raise a hand and point at your window.
I can feel your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的词够得着。
lines.en: At this range my words will reach.

lines.zh: 水里没有你，可你会下来。
lines.en: The water has no you in it, yet down you'll come.
I choose the one carrying the lantern.

lines.zh: 地开始潮了，你还没发现。
lines.en: The ground is dampening and you haven't noticed.
I've memorized this street.
In a little while it will all be the sea's.
I follow you with very light steps.

lines.zh: 你跑过的地方，草都变咸。
lines.en: The grass turns salt where you run.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你脚下的地方塌了。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the ground under you gives way.
You circle; I circle too, slowly.

lines.zh: 你躲进屋，我就在门外站。
lines.en: You hide indoors. I stand outside the door.
Water starts seeping under the door.

lines.zh: 我听见你们在里面说话。
lines.en: I hear you talking inside.
No hurry. I'll wait for the tide.

lines.zh: 你在窗口看我，我看见你了。
lines.en: You're watching me from the window. I see you.
Everything in this range is mine.
I sweep my hand and spikes burst from the ground.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把光砸在你身上。
lines.en: I raise my hand and bring the light down on you.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的皮开始变硬。
lines.en: That one made your skin start to harden.

lines.zh: 我隔着十步，就能打到你。
lines.en: I can strike you from ten paces away.
My words have their teeth in you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，珊瑚缠住你的脚。
lines.en: I raise a hand and coral winds around your feet.
That blow borrowed force from the sea floor.
I step back half a pace and start again.

lines.zh: 你身上已经有海的东西了。
lines.en: There's something of the sea in you already.
I smile and finish the last line.
The water opens under the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我从海里走上来，一步没停。
lines.en: I walk up out of the sea without breaking stride.
My robe is full of water. It's heavy.

lines.zh: 岸上的草，立刻枯了一半。
lines.en: Half the grass on the shore withers at once.
This place is drier than I expected.

lines.zh: 唤灵者的袍角，缠着湿海草。
lines.en: The hem of my evoker robe is tangled with wet kelp.
I count the lights. Several dozen.
The sea is coming this way.
I've only come a step ahead of it.

lines.zh: 我念了第一句，风就变了。
lines.en: I speak the first line and the wind turns.

lines.zh: 火燎过袍子，我抖落海盐扑灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my robe and I shake sea salt onto it.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下，袍子里全是水。
lines.en: I fall from a height, robe full of water.

lines.zh: 我在陆上长大，水也开始让我难受。
lines.en: I grew on land, and even water turns on me now.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，袍子撕开。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and tears my robe.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的肩膀，我没拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder. I leave it.

lines.zh: 陆地的咒语，碰到我时响了。
lines.en: A land spell hisses when it touches me.

lines.zh: 我离海太远，喂不饱自己。
lines.en: I'm too far from the sea to feed myself.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整身都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and I light up all over.

lines.zh: 这里没有海，什么都没有。
lines.en: There's no sea here. There's nothing.
